articles.title: Google Gives Gemini Control of Mac Apps, But Its New AI Agent Comes With Risks
articles.snippet: Gemini's new Mac computer-use feature navigates apps, files, and websites in a separate window, but Google's own documentation warns about prompt injection.

articles.title: Binance Wins $6.5B Freezing Order Over Hack That Can Be Served via the Blockchain
articles.snippet: An Abu Dhabi court's worldwide injunction targets the unknown hackers, backed by a "living list" of 26,000 wallets holding stolen funds.
